citations.text: A. Vrani, S. D. Apostolidis, A. C. Kapoutsis, E. B. Kosmatopoulos (2025). Delivering data: A real-world dataset for last-mile delivery optimization. Data in Brief 61, 111762.

description: Distance and time matrices, service times and time windows for a real pharmaceutical last-mile delivery operation.
name: Pharmaceutical last-mile delivery dataset (Vrani et al.)

recipe.reason: The zip holds an orders workbook with a sheet for each of nine daily instances, whose rows give a node's weight, volume, service time, earliest arrival, latitude and time window, beside workbooks of distance and time matrices; a collection reads a file for each instance, not a sheet, and keepset does not read a workbook inside a zip.
